question_en:
I am organizing historical hurricane cases for a disaster prevention exhibition on the North Carolina Outer Banks, specifically focusing on storms that crossed the Bahamas and then made landfall on the North Carolina coast. The attachment is a post-hurricane photo. Please answer the following questions:

1. Which hurricane caused the disaster shown in the image? Provide the hurricane name and year.
2. Among the storms recorded in the NHC Atlantic HURDAT2 dataset from 1996 to 2019, which storms had centers that crossed the Atlantic coastline between Cape Fear and Cape Hatteras, North Carolina, at hurricane intensity, and whose official Tropical Cyclone Report Figure 1 path centerlines, labeled as "hurricane" or "major hurricane," passed over the land outline of at least one Bahamas island before making landfall in North Carolina? List the names and years of all storms meeting these criteria.

Answer format: For Question 1, provide the hurricane name and year in text. For Question 2, list all qualifying storm names and years in a table.
answer:
Question 1: Hurricane Dorian, 2019.

Question 2:

| Storm Name | Year |
| --- | --- |
| Hurricane Floyd | 1999 |
| Hurricane Irene | 2011 |
| Hurricane Dorian | 2019 |
